import sys

def solve(n, k, s, t):
    # Reduce t until divisible by n (iterative version of recursive reduce)
    while t % n != 0:
        delta = (1 if s < k else -1) * (t % n)
        s = (s + n + delta) % n
        t -= 1
    t //= n

    when = [-1] * n
    left = t
    while left > 0:
        if when[s] != -1:
            period = when[s] - left
            for i in range(n):
                if when[i] != -1 and when[i] <= when[s] and when[i] % period == 0:
                    return i
            raise AssertionError("No cycle found")
        when[s] = left
        for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
            if s < k:
                s += i
                if s >= n:
                    s -= n
            else:
                s -= i
                if s < 0:
                    s += n
        left -= 1
    return s

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    k = data[1]
    s = data[2] - 1
    t = data[3]
    result = solve(n, k, s, t) + 1
    sys.stdout.write(str(result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
